Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Brijesh Kumar Prajapati, learned counsel for the informant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present second bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No. 128 of 2021, under Sections 342, 363, 376 of IPC and 4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act,
2012, Police Station Girwan, District Banda with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

sentences.text: It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is further submitted that statement of the victim was recorded before the trial Court as per which the victim was major at the time of incident.
Victim performed marriage and she is having one child.
There are material contradictions with regard to the place of occurrence.
It is further submitted that as per the radiological report, her age was determined to be 17 years at the time of incident.

It is further submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 07.09.2021 having no criminal history and that in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.

sentences.text: Per contra, the learned Additional Government Advocate assisted by learned counsel for the informant has opposed the prayer for grant of bail by contending that victim in her statement recorded before the trial court has corroborated the prosecution version and made specific allegation of rape against the applicant.

All the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant have already been considered by this court while disposal of the first bail application and applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.

Considering the rival submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of allegations, gravity of offence and the fact that all aspects of the matter has already been considered while disposal of the first bail application and no new ground has been taken in the present second bail application, I do not find it a fit case for bail.
Hence, the bail application is hereby rejected.

However, the trial court is directed to expedite the trial and make every endeavour to conclude the same expeditiously, preferably, within a period of one year from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties subject to full co-operation by the applicant, if there is no legal impediment.
